[?] Windows server / online play: server and clients build identical buildings from the same seed. On a Dedicated Server build, `StructureKit.CollidersOnly` turns on automatically and skips meshes and renderers. A batchmode player started with -nographics also turns it on. Setting it by hand before world generation also works. Across different CPUs (x64 server, ARM Mac clients), rare floating-point edge cases could change a layout decision. I didn't see this happen, but if collision ever disagrees between server and client, the server's version should be treated as correct.
